verified_facts.text: The hotel has neoclassical architecture.
verified_facts.excerpt: starting with its neoclassical architecture.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is located downtown near the railway station in Tianjin.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located downtown near the railway station, this hotel with a swimming pool in Tianjin offers the perfect location for exploring China’s third-largest city.

verified_facts.text: The hotel presents more than 1,200 pieces of artwork on display, with background stories from the western to the eastern world.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Ritz-Carlton, Tianjin presents more than 1,200 pieces of artwork on display with rich background stories from the western to the eastern world.

verified_facts.text: In-house guests can join a half-hour Art Tour of the hotel's artwork, with the guide waiting in the centre of the lobby.
verified_facts.excerpt: The tour guide will be waiting for you in the center of the hotel lobby.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Tianjin has the China rose as its emblem and uses ESPA products in its signature treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Signature and luxury treatments harness the regenerative and healing properties of the rose as well as other ESPA products and time-honored rituals.

verified_facts.text: The spa has two relaxation lounges and eight treatment rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Within the spa’s two relaxation lounges and eight spacious treatment rooms

verified_facts.text: The spa and fitness area has Technogym exercise equipment, an indoor swimming pool, and sauna and steam facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: It offers Technogym exercise equipment, an indoor swimming pool, and sauna and steam facilities.

verified_facts.text: Tian Tai Xuan serves Cantonese and Tianjin dishes in a fine-dining setting, afternoon tea is served at The Lobby Lounge, and Zest has live cooking stations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tian Tai Xuan pairs Cantonese and Tianjin dishes with a fine-dining ambience, Afternoon Tea embodies tradition at The Lobby Lounge and live cooking stations inspire excitement at Zest restaurant in Tianjin.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has four restaurants and bars.
verified_facts.excerpt: at the hotel’s four restaurants and bars.

verified_facts.text: Zest is built within the hotel's courtyard and has three private dining rooms in addition to the main hall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Constructed within the hotel’s courtyard and featuring three private dining rooms in addition to the main hall, Zest

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is available onsite at Zest for a fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, breakfast is available onsite at ZEST for a fee.

verified_facts.text: The Club Lounge is designed as a residential concept with five areas: an open kitchen, a private dining room, a family room, a library and a bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed as a residential concept, the Club Lounge features five distinct areas: an open kitchen, a private dining room, a family room, a library and a bar.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have balconies with a city, garden or courtyard view.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guest rooms and luxury hotel suites with balconies offer a city, garden or courtyard view.

verified_facts.text: The Ritz Kids program is designed for children aged four to eight and is guided by the culture, history and setting of Tianjin.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel’s Ritz Kids program offers a family-friendly experience guided by the culture, history and setting of Tianjin. The program, designed for kids ages four to eight

verified_facts.text: Ritz Kids participation must be reserved at least three days in advance.
verified_facts.excerpt: Participation in Ritz Kids must be reserved at least three days in advance.

verified_facts.text: Tianjin is half an hour from Beijing by high-speed train.
verified_facts.excerpt: Though it’s just half an hour from Beijing via high-speed train

verified_facts.text: Transportation is offered in a Rolls Royce or Bentley.
verified_facts.excerpt: transportation in a Rolls Royce or Bentley

verified_facts.text: Online reservations are not available for the spa; an appointment is required.
verified_facts.excerpt: An appointment is required at The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Tianjin.

verified_facts.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
verified_facts.excerpt: *Club access requires an upgraded booking at the Club. Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The Ritz-Carlton, Tianjin.
